real.prompt: Build a CRM with login, contacts, companies, deal pipeline, dashboard analytics, admin and sales roles, and premium billing.
Create a hospital management app with doctors, patients, appointments, prescriptions, billing, role-based access for admin, doctor, and receptionist.
Build an e-commerce admin panel with products, categories, orders, inventory, coupons, analytics, and staff permissions.
Create a project management platform with teams, tasks, comments, kanban board, deadlines, notifications, and subscription tiers.
Build a learning platform with students, instructors, courses, lessons, quizzes, progress tracking, payments, and admin analytics.
Create a HRMS system with employee records, payroll, attendance, leave requests, managers, admins, and reporting dashboard.
Build a restaurant ordering app with menus, tables, kitchen status, orders, billing, cashier role, waiter role, and admin reports.
Create a SaaS bug tracker with login, workspaces, projects, issues, comments, attachments, role-based permissions, and premium plan gating.
Build a real estate CRM with agents, properties, leads, site visits, commissions, admin analytics, and team roles.
Create an event management system with organizers, attendees, tickets, payments, check-in, staff roles, and sales dashboard.

edge.prompt: Build something like a business app for a small company.
Create a CRM where users do not need login, but only admins and managers can access analytics.
Build an app with payments but no user accounts, subscriptions, or customer records.
Make a hospital system with patients, but no database.
Create an admin dashboard with role-based access, except everyone should be able to do everything.
Build an e-commerce site with products, orders, checkout, but do not store customer or order information.
Create a social app with messages, friendships, notifications, and zero API endpoints.
Build a dashboard for analytics. That's it.
Create a school ERP with students, fees, attendance, exams, teachers, parent portal, but keep everything in one giant table.
Build a premium SaaS app with free users, premium users, enterprise users, and no authentication system.
